notes: muuto.com is a single global site (no /en-us/ path); the US catalogue is selected via the assortment group. Switched the session to the USA assortment (POST /api/assortment-group/set {"AssortmentGroupId":"united_states_of_america"}; GET /api/assortment-group/current then returns id=united_states_of_america and all prices render as USD). Every qty is the number the PLP itself prints in its filter bar (template '${availableTotalResults} items'), which the bundle sets from the listing API's totalHits (main.js: performProductFiltering -> commit('updateAvailableTotalResults', s.totalHits)). Each qty was confirmed twice and independently: the server-rendered attribute initial-available-total-results on the <tile-filter> component of the category page, and totalHits from GET /api/products?pageId=<id>. Both agreed for all 8 rows. Counts differ per category (and differ from the APMEA assortment, e.g. Table Lamps 18 APMEA vs 14 USA), so these are not a site-wide constant. Small boutique catalogue - only these 8 sub-categories qualify. Excluded per brief: Accessories > Rugs / Cushions / Throws (textiles), Accessories > Storage and Accessories > Office (storage/office), Accessories > Hangers (coat hooks and racks - hardware), Outdoor > Accessories (cushions, covers, seat pads, outdoor rug), and all Seating / Sofas / Tables / Storage furniture trees. Parent aggregate pages (/products/lighting/ = 33 items, /products/accessories/ = 42 items) were not written as rows since they are 'All' roll-ups. Note the grid de-duplicates masters so it can render fewer distinct tiles than the printed item count (the count includes variant-level records); the printed number is still what the site reports, so it is what is recorded.
